customMethods.name: clearData
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("clearData() called")

	self.view.custom.assets.clearSelection = True	
	
	self.view.custom.itemStates.data = system.dataset.clearDataset(self.view.custom.itemStates.data)
	self.view.custom.itemStates.row = None
	self.view.custom.itemStates.col = None	
	
	self.view.custom.assetStates.data = system.dataset.clearDataset(self.view.custom.assetStates.data)
	self.view.custom.assetStates.row = None
	self.view.custom.assetStates.col = None	

	return

customMethods.name: linkItemStates
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("linkItemStates() called")
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	userSelection = self.view.custom.userSelection
	
	
	linkInfo = {
					'itemStateId' : userSelection['itemStateInfo'][0]['itemStateId'] if userSelection['itemStateInfo'][0].has_key('itemStateId') else None,
					'itemStateClassId': userSelection['itemStateInfo'][0]['itemStateClassId'] if userSelection['itemStateInfo'][0].has_key('itemStateClassId') else None,
					'assetId': None,
					'itemId': None,
					'itemClassId': None
				}

	assets = [asset['assetId'] for asset in userSelection['assetInfo']] if len(userSelection['assetInfo']) > 0 else [None]
	items = [item['itemId'] for item in userSelection['itemInfo'] if item.has_key('itemId')]
	itemClasses = [item['itemClassId'] for item in userSelection['itemInfo'] if item.has_key('itemClassId')]
	
#	system.perspective.print("linkInfo %s"%linkInfo)
#	system.perspective.print("assets %s"%assets)
#	system.perspective.print("items %s"%items)
#	system.perspective.print("itemClasses %s"%itemClasses)
	
	for assetId in assets:
		linkInfo['assetId'] = assetId
		
		if len(items) == 0 and len(itemClasses) == 0:
			itemStateLinkId, msg = system.kanoa.item.linkItemStates(linkInfo, userId)
			system.perspective.print("itemStateLinkId %s | msg %s"%(itemStateLinkId, msg))
		
		for itemId in items:
			linkInfo['itemId'] = itemId
			itemStateLinkId, msg = system.kanoa.item.linkItemStates(linkInfo, userId)
			system.perspective.print("itemStateLinkId %s | msg %s"%(itemStateLinkId, msg))

		for itemClassId in itemClasses:
			linkInfo['itemId'] = None
			linkInfo['itemClassId'] = itemClassId
			itemStateLinkId, msg = system.kanoa.item.linkItemStates(linkInfo, userId)
			system.perspective.print("itemStateLinkId %s | msg %s"%(itemStateLinkId, msg))
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemStateLinks.data")
	
	return

customMethods.name: unlinkItemStates
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("unlinkItemStates() called")
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	
	for row in self.view.custom.itemStateLinks.selectedData:
		system.perspective.print("Unlinking %s"%row['itemStateLinkId'])
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.item.unlinkItemState(row['itemStateLinkId'], userId)
		if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': msg})
		system.perspective.print("%s %s"%(retVal, msg))
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemStateLinks.data")
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteItemStates
deleteItemStateClass
customMethods.script:
itemStateClassInfo = self.view.custom.itemStateClass.selected
	if itemStateClassInfo and itemStateClassInfo.has_key('itemStateClassId'):
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.item.deleteItemStateClass(itemStateClassInfo['itemStateClassId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
		if retVal:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Item State Class has been deleted'})
		else:
			if 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg) or 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the SAME TABLE REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
				msg = 'This Item Class has items beneath it. Please delete items within this class before deleting this Item Class'
	#			system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteAssetHistory'}, title='Delete Asset and Historical data', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg})
	
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemStateClass.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemStates.data")
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemStates.filteredData")
	
	return
